items.name: Berkeley December Weekday 2026

venue.name: SOCS 20
venue.details: This venue is NOT the normal Pauley Ballroom venue!

items.information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings. For 4x4, we will accept a maximum of 24 competitors. If you have 4x4 in your event list after 24 other people sign up for 4x4, it will be removed from your registration when you get accepted.

items.name: Bulgarian Nationals 2026

venue.name: Experimentarium hall of Sofia Tech Park
venue.address: Sofia, 111B Tsarigradsko shose, "Experimentarium" hall - Sofia Tech Park
venue.details: The entry to the hall is directly after the bridge above Tsarigradsko shose blv.

items.information: Maximum 1 guest per competitor. Registration fee to be paid by bank transfer no more than 48 hours after you have been registered for the competition. Once the tax is made you will be added to the approved list shorthly after that.. You can choose on which day of the competition you will participate. The fee for Guests and Spectators to be paid in the venue on the day of the competition and is 3 euro/day. You can choose on which day of the competition you will participate for one or all the days of the competition.. The address of Techno Magic Land is: 111B Tsarigradsko shose, "Experimentarium" hall - Sofia Tech Park. ---------- Допустими са максимум 1 гост с всеки състезател. Таксата за участие се заплаща по банков път до 48 часа след като сте се регистрирали. Впоследствие ще бъдете добавени към официалния списък. Таксата за зрители и гости се заплаща в деня на състезанието и е в размер на 3 евро/ден. Можете да избирате в кой от дните ще се състезавате. Адресът на Техно меджик ленд е: 1784 гр. София, бул. Цариградско шосе 111Б, сграда "Експериментариум" - София Тех Парк

items.information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Cube Championship 2026! ​ [![](https://i.imgur.com/oRN01S9m.jpg)](https://beacons.ai/malaysiacubechampionship) ​ Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information. **Please note** Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, There will be **2 types of winner** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Malaysian Category** - Top 3 Malaysian winners of the competition Participants representing Malaysia will have the opportunity to win special trophies, prizes, and the title of Malaysia Champion. The number of competitors in all final rounds may increase until there are at least 6 Malaysian competitors who advance **If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Information & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaCubeChampionship2026#81105-information-announcements) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.** Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. • ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
